# makeUniforms

## Summary

Builds the shared uniform set used by all four shader passes (voxels, halo, grid, ring): animation time, tree/sphere morph, atlas open/closed, chroma clamp, slice mode and position, lattice density, glow, scale, plus the camera-basis vectors (`uCamR` / `uCamU` / `uCamF`) and pick anchor as `THREE.Vector3` slots. Lives in `tree-engine` because that module is the single owner of the CDN three.js import.

## Import

```javascript
import { makeUniforms, type Uniforms } from '../utils/tree-engine';
```

## Usage

```javascript
let uniforms = makeUniforms();
let material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  uniforms,
  vertexShader: VOXEL_VSH,
  fragmentShader: VOXEL_FSH,
});
uniforms.uMorph.value = 1; // morph the tree into Itten's sphere
```
